general.html: corporate office 915 N Mansfield Ave, Hollywood, CA 90038 (hq_country US); 'Standard Shipping (Ground) is provided for all US orders' and orders ship only within the 'Delivery Zone' (no other countries named, so ships_to is US only); returns 'within thirty (30) calendar days from the delivery date', return labels prepaid; website purchases can't be returned to stores.

locations.html lists 10 US boutiques: Aspen, Honolulu, Las Vegas (Caesars Palace, Fontainebleau, Wynn Plaza), Los Angeles, Malibu, Miami, New York West Village and Upper East Side; plus St. Barth, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, UK and France.

Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chrome_Hearts): founded 1988 in a Los Angeles garage by Richard Stark, John Bowman and Leonard Kamhout (Bloomberg, Hypebeast, Chicago Tribune citations); Bowman and Kamhout left in 1994; co-owned today by Richard Stark and Laurie Lynn Stark (Complex citation), private, no parent; known for silver, gold and diamond accessories plus eyewear, leather, apparel and furniture; most items made in Hollywood, eyewear mainly in Japan, fragrance in France; sold through its own boutiques and retailers such as Bergdorf Goodman and Selfridges. known_for 'Silver Jewelry and Leather' is from this, since the brand's own pages state no positioning.
